system.description:
Level 8.

When using Rank 2 or Rank 1 components to summon Spirit Beasts, each component type grants a unique benefit (in addition to Rank 3 benefits still applying for Rank 3 components):

Rank 2 Unique: Crimson +3 dmg | Violet -2 more dmg | Azure +2 Dodge | Sage Energizes Party regardless of range

Rank 2 Bones: +3 Speed | Sensories: First instance nullified | Hearts: +7 Health

Rank 1 Unique: Crimson +5 dmg | Violet -4 more dmg | Azure +3 Dodge | Sage Defense also Stuns

Rank 1 Bones: +4 Speed | Sensories: 1st and 2nd instance nullified | Hearts: +10 Health
